claims.statement: The design system is layered strictly downward: semantic tokens in src/styles/globals.css (Tailwind v4 CSS-first, tailwind.config.ts deleted) feed generic shadcn primitives in src/components/ui, which feed presentational product-composition families in src/components/product, consumed by route-owned UI.
Primitives in src/components/ui are domain-agnostic, use semantic tokens only (no hardcoded or light-only palette values), and preserve existing exports, variants, portals, and compatibility props.

Product compositions in src/components/product are presentational and route-supplied: they own no URL/search/debounce/persistence/query/API/store logic, and each family has a source-contract test with an explicit Story-owned manifest that rejects such ownership.
PageHeader renders exactly one logical h1 per route (title must be non-empty), and ContextBar conveys semantic state as localized text, never by color alone.

FinancialValue and MetricCard preserve zero-vs-missing-vs-unavailable distinctions: nullish or non-finite metric input never becomes a fabricated zero, and compact display requires a caller-supplied fullValue string.

The tables family (ResponsiveTable, TablePagination, TableState, VirtualizedTableFrame) is a route-free semantic-table foundation with explicit TableNarrowStrategy and TableConsumerContract, deliberately without a client-side data-engine dependency such as TanStack Table; the charts subtree imports no Recharts.

PageState is a discriminated prop union where every state requires a title, explanation, and trust statement; retained kinds require limitation plus retained children, and terminal states cannot fabricate retained content or a zero. src/app/not-found.tsx is the global not-found owner rendering PageState not-found.

As of 2026-08-26 the 94-story migration program is at 51 canonical stories complete: Epics 166, 167, 168, and 170 closed; Epic 171 in progress at 6/9; Epic 169 at 11/15 awaiting its 169.14→169.15→169.12 contract tail; Epics 172–174 in backlog. Full Vitest floor 19 253/0 with lint 0/0 and tsc 0.

Epic 170 (marketing analytics, 7/7) migrated the advertising route with route-local token maps (advertising-tokens.ts, daily-trend-config.ts, ad-cost-discrepancy-config.ts), sr-only DailyTrendSrTable, status /15+/30 matched-pair banners, and honest-null meta.last_sync; plus campaign detail, brand, brand-share, category, cross-reference (single-source channel-styling and one-source-partial coexistence), and search (page-level ?tab=/?nmId= deep link with precedence ?tab= > ?query= > orders).

Story 171.2 delivered the epic AX literal 'focus returns to the invoking row' in the ai-admin models rollback dialog: because the dialog is conditionally unmounted with no AlertDialogTrigger, the invoking row's rollback button is captured before unmount and re-queried inside a requestAnimationFrame (a background refetch may remount the row between capture and frame); AdminModelsContent also distinguishes filter-empty from no-data empty.

Story 171.4 migrated the forecast route: ForecastChart's confidence-band cutout uses a background token (dark-mode fix), 13 chart hexes were removed, an sr-only ForecastChartSrTable exposes every date's data, and forecast series deliberately carry no financial-valence token semantics.

Story 171.6 migrated the model-registry root by replacing 7 light-only palette classes in STATUS_BADGE_CONFIG (model-list-helpers.ts) with semantic status tokens while freezing the {className,label,pulse} shape, because the unmigrated [id] subroutes (EvaluationsHeaderCard, ModelPerformanceDetail) read className; removal of the field is delegated to Stories 171.7/171.9. Epic 171 remainder is 171.7, 171.8, 171.9.

Every migrated route ships a *-presentation-source-contracts guard: comment-stripped owned production files must contain no raw hex and no Tailwind palette classes (regexes with self-tests), with a pinned owned-file catalog and explicit exclusions for unmigrated subtrees (advertising excludes campaigns/[advertId]; model-registry excludes [id]/**). Guards exist for advertising, anomalies, brand-share, campaign-detail, cross-reference, forecast, forecast-accuracy, funnel, gaps, liquidity, model-registry, returns, search, storage, and supply-planning.

The 170.1 advertising guard embeds a C4 state-disposition matrix documenting, for each data state (initial loading, background refresh, global vs filtered empty, sync gaps, over-attribution, partial daily/finance, stale), whether it is TESTED, N/A-with-evidence, or route-owned; background refresh is manual-only (refetchInterval 0, no polling), a deliberate preserved pre-migration behavior.

Outstanding migration debt: the Epic 169 contract tail (169.14 backend → 169.15 shared FE → 169.12 closeout, with 169.12 route presentation merged but review-blocked), Epic 171's 171.7–171.9 models [id] subroutes, a load-dependent sidebar→supply-planning E2E flake queued for hardening before 172.1, browser/theme/visual evidence deferred to 174.3, and credentialed functional E2E to 174.4.

Non-negotiable migration principles: behavior preserved before presentation, one shared file = one upstream owner story, never shadcn init --force, meaning never hidden behind color/hover/truncation/viewport, and local validation (targeted vitest suites plus build for token edits) is the merge gate rather than the full suite.

Story 171.3 (ai-admin preferences) was a NO-OP verdict plus micro-fixes — the mutation-error Alert id joined into the Switch's describedby chain and a max-w-2xl readable form width; Story 171.1 (anomalies) closed 7 contract gaps on a token-clean-born route, including 409-conflict as a distinct honest state and a polite single pending announcement.
